cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?

mechanism: A grades its former organizing pupil success measures while probing the pupil personal payoff and A comparative standing as picnic organizer.
confusable: Not simply demanding praise or accusing secret competition: A asks the criterion, beneficiary and rank explicitly through new answers.
comparison: Organizational evaluation linked to reelection versus club vote linked to a preferred project.
